subheadline.en: I build software and AI on Azure that survives contact with real users.
subheadline.id: Saya membangun software dan AI di Azure yang tetap tangguh saat dipakai pengguna sungguhan.

bio.en: I am a software engineer and AI engineer based in Jakarta. Since February 2026 I design, build and operate Azure AI applications at Metrodata for clients in banking, automotive, mining and food manufacturing: realtime voice agents, document AI, AI security tooling and grounded RAG assistants. Before that I spent four years building backends and full-stack products for e-commerce, travel, SaaS and digital banking, from MNC and Jatis to Jenius.
bio.id: Saya software engineer sekaligus AI engineer yang berbasis di Jakarta. Sejak Februari 2026 saya merancang, membangun, dan mengoperasikan aplikasi Azure AI di Metrodata untuk klien perbankan, otomotif, pertambangan, dan manufaktur makanan: voice agent realtime, document AI, tooling keamanan berbasis AI, serta asisten RAG yang grounded. Sebelumnya, selama empat tahun saya membangun backend dan produk full-stack untuk e-commerce, travel, SaaS, dan perbankan digital, mulai dari MNC dan Jatis hingga Jenius.

story.en: It started in a vocational school lab in Malang in 2016, with Android tutorials and a new GitHub account. Competition trophies followed, at school and then at Telkom University (20 placings, seven of them first places, from a chatbot prototype to data science and capture-the-flag). I helped lead a 200-student programming club and trained an IndoBERT model to read how students felt about their campus, while a part-time e-commerce backend paid for the late nights. Then came the production years: travel payments at MNC, multi-tenant SaaS at Jatis and digital-banking integrations at Jenius. In 2026 I joined Metrodata's Microsoft AI practice and changed how I build: I write the spec, send AI coding agents out in parallel and stand at the merge gate. Voice agents you can interrupt mid-sentence, a security platform that opens its own fix PRs, document AI that is not allowed to guess: every system ships with an evaluation that can say no.
story.id: Semuanya dimulai di lab SMK di Malang pada 2016, berbekal tutorial Android dan akun GitHub yang masih baru. Piala kompetisi menyusul, sejak SMK hingga di Telkom University (20 kali naik podium, tujuh di antaranya juara 1, dari prototipe chatbot sampai data science dan capture-the-flag). Saya ikut memimpin klub programming beranggotakan 200 mahasiswa dan melatih model IndoBERT untuk membaca perasaan mahasiswa tentang kampusnya, sementara backend e-commerce paruh waktu membiayai malam-malam panjang itu. Lalu datang tahun-tahun produksi: pembayaran travel di MNC, SaaS multi-tenant di Jatis, dan integrasi perbankan digital di Jenius. Pada 2026 saya bergabung dengan praktik Microsoft AI di Metrodata dan mengubah cara saya membangun: saya menulis spec, menjalankan AI coding agent secara paralel, dan berjaga di merge gate. Voice agent yang bisa disela di tengah kalimat, platform keamanan yang membuka PR perbaikannya sendiri, document AI yang tidak boleh menebak: setiap sistem dirilis bersama evaluasi yang berani berkata tidak.

howIWork.en: Every feature starts as a written spec with acceptance criteria. AI coding agents (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) do much of the typing in parallel, while I own the design, the review, verification on Azure and the merge. Evaluation is part of the product: gold sets, A/B tests, CI gates and shadow mode, and every number ships with how it was measured.
howIWork.id: Setiap fitur berawal dari spec tertulis lengkap dengan acceptance criteria. AI coding agent (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) mengerjakan sebagian besar penulisan kode secara paralel, sementara saya memegang desain, review, verifikasi di Azure, dan keputusan merge. Evaluasi adalah bagian dari produk: gold set, A/B test, CI gate, dan shadow mode, dan setiap angka selalu disertai cara pengukurannya.
